section_prompt_translated: National flag is a flag that symbolizes a nation. In the past, triangular flags were mostly used, but in recent years, most nations use rectangular flags except for Nepal. The aspect ratio varies slightly from country to country, but there is no flag that has its height longer than its width. On the other hand, only Switzerland and the Vatican use square flags. Like the ratio of width and height that is usually drawn at 3:2 which ignores the slight differences in national flags, there are a number of cases where they display all types of red as the same red and all types of blue as the same blue, which is clearly wrong. For example, for the red color, the red in the American flag, in the British Union Jack, and in the French tricolor are all different. The red in the American flag is slightly purple, with less yellow, bluer, and a very slight addition of black, but the British flag is closer to pure red, and French flag is a bright red with a lot of yellow. In the past, there were slight color differences due to the different types of dyes and favorite colors in each country, which people did not regard it as important as they do today; since coloring and printing techniques are developed these days, countries often specify the designated colors used in national flags in law. However, the two ends of achromatic colors, black and white, use pure black and pure white in most cases.

section_prompt_translated: Shaka signs, a unique hand movement when surfers fold three of their fingers and extend the thumb and the pinky finger in the opposite direction, can be seen in beautiful beaches. Shaka signs represent ‘aloha spirit’ of native Hawaiians, which symbolizes friendship, love, understanding among Hawaiians. There are various stories about the origin of the Shaka sign. Some people claim it is originated from Spanish emigrants who migrated to Hawaii, and others argue that it originated from a surfer who had lost his three fingers in shark attack. The most convincing story among much storytelling is that a laborer who had worked at sugar cane field lost three fingers by mistake, and others imitated the way he greeted others. Whatever the origin is, Shaka sign has become a traditional Hawaiian greeting and it has set friendly international relations to promote Hawaii. Shaka signs became widely known to surfers worldwide when it was in trend in 1960s California, the United States, and as Hawaiian surfers showed Shaka signs to other surfers, and when it was used in an ad by a salesman who sold Hawaiian local TV cars.

section_prompt: 주머니늑대는 오스트레일리아의 태즈메이니아 섬에 서식했던 포유류 중 육식 유대류에 속한다. 등에 호랑이와 비슷한 무늬를 가졌기 때문에 태즈메이니아 호랑이라고도 불리지만 실제 외모나 생활사는 개과에 가까웠다. 역사 시대에 있었던 육식 포유류 중 입을 가장 크게 벌릴 수 있었는데, 단순히 입이 커서가 아니라 골격 구조 자체에 차이가 있기 때문에 모양만 보면 마치 뱀이나 악어가 연상될 정도로 골격에 비해 입을 크게 벌릴 수 있었다. 유대류로서는 특이하게도 암수 모두 육아 주머니가 존재한다. 하지만, 수컷의 육아 주머니는 새끼를 키우기 위한 용도가 아니라 생식기를 보호하기 위한 용도이다. 본래 주머니늑대는 오스트레일리아 대륙 및 뉴기니 섬 일대에 서식하고 있었지만, 3만년전에 인간이 진출하면서 인류나 야생개인 딩고에게 먹이를 빼앗기고 인류가 발을 디디지 않았던 태즈메이니아 섬에만 살게 되었다. 양 등의 가축을 해치는 유해동물로 여겨진 주머니늑대는 모피용, 오락용으로 대량 학살당했고, 1900년을 전후해 급격히 수가 줄어들었다. 주머니늑대는 역사 시대까지 살아남은 육식 유대류 중 가장 거대했지만 1930년대에 보호하던 마지막 개체인 ‘벤저민’마저 죽음으로 인해 멸종했다. 이후 살아있는 개체를 목격했다는 소문이 있긴 하지만 아직까지 정확한 증거는 없다.
section_prompt_translated: The thylacine is a carnivorous marsupial, a type of mammal that used to inhabit islands of Tasmania in Australia. Although the Thylacine was known as the Tasmania tiger because of its stripes on the back that looked like a tiger, its actual appearance and life cycle was close to Canidae. The Thylacine could open its mouth the widest among carnivorous mammals in the historical era. It simply was not because of its big mouth but was because of different physical structure which enabled it to open its mouth wider compared to its physique, such as a snake and a crocodile. Both females and males interestingly had a pouch which was distinctively unique from other marsupials. However, the pouch of a male is not for rearing its young but for protecting its genitals. The thylacine was originally native to the Australian mainland and the islands of New Guinea, but after humans advanced 30,000 years ago, it fell prey to humanity and wild dogs named Dingo and it was cornered to islands of Tasmania which was out of reach of humanity. As the thylacine was considered as an animal pest that causes harm to cattle such as sheep, it was slaughtered for fur and entertainment which dramatically dwindled its population since the 1900s. Even though the thylacine was the largest carnivorous mammal that existed until the historical era, it became extinct following the extinction of an cub known as ‘Benjamin’ that was conserved in the 1930s. Henceforth, there have been rumors about witnessing a living entity, but there is no accurate evidence yet.
item_text_translated: Does the male thylacine have a pouch?

section_prompt_translated: World Environment Day is annually celebrated on June 5th which is a legal anniversary established to foster public awareness of environmental preservation and daily practices. At the Stockholm Conference, which included various countries, international organizations and private organizations, each nation adopted the "United Nations Declaration of Human Environment" and designated June 5th as World Environment Day at the UN General Assembly which also was the opening day of the Human Environment Conference. Since 1974, it has been held continuously to raise awareness of new environmental issues such as global warming, marine pollution, and crimes against wildlife. World Environment Day is annually participated by many countries, businesses, NGOs, and celebrities from all over the world to adopt new topics on environmental issues. For example, the theme for World Environment Day in 2018 was "Fighting Plastic Pollution" which was hosted by India. The Indian government will set a good example for people around the world by cleaning up plastic waste in public, in national nature reserves, and in forests. The event will call for governments, businesses, civil society, and individuals to seek sustainable alternatives to plastic waste and reduce the production and consumption of disposable plastics that threaten the marine environment and human health.

section_prompt: 단안경은 안경의 한 종류로서 한쪽 눈에만 끼는 독특한 특성 때문에 외눈 안경이라고도 부른다. 단안경은 둥근 렌즈로 만들어졌는데, 보통 철테가 둘러져 있고 끈도 달려 있다. 끈의 한쪽 끝은 안경 분실을 막기 위해 옷에 달려있는 게 보통이다. 1820년에 영국에서 처음 모습을 드러낸 단안경은 고위급 공무원, 장교, 외교관이 주로 착용했었다고 한다. 시력 교정보다는 패션에 중점을 둔 물건으로 상류층에서 주로 착용하여 신분을 나타내는 악세사리로써의 역할도 하며 프로이센 귀족의 상징 같은 소품이 되었다. 원산지인 영국을 넘어 근대 유럽에서 한때 광범위하게 유행했던 물건이다. 단안경은 19세기 말까지 유행하다가 1~2차세계대전 직후에 잠깐 보게 되었고, 특히 2차세계대전때 독일군 고위 장교들이 심심치 않게 착용했었다고 한다. 이후 오늘날에는 단안경을 거의 쓰지 않는데 이것이 시력 교정 기능을 제대로 하지 못하지 때문이다. 두 눈의 시력이 모두 나쁜 경우에 단안경을 사용하면 한쪽 눈만 잘 보이고 다른 쪽은 그대로인 상태가 되는데, 이때 어지러움이 동반되고 균형감각 및 원근 감각에 이상을 끼친다.
section_prompt_translated: A monocle is a type of eyeglasses that is also known as one eyeglass because of its distinctive characteristic which only fits in one eye. A monocle is made of a circular lens with a wire around it and a string attached to it. One end of the strap is usually attached to the clothes to prevent losing glasses. First seen in 1820 in England, the monocle was said to have been worn mainly by high-ranking officials, officers, and diplomats. It was dominantly worn by the upper class as a fashionable item rather than eye correction and it served as an accessory to the social status of the upper class, making it a symbol of the Prussian aristocracy. It was only widely popular not only in Great Britain where it was first produced but in modern Europe as well. The monocle was in vogue until the end of the 19th century and was briefly worn shortly after World War I and II; it was often worn by high-ranking German officers during World War II. Today, the monocle is not worn as often as before because it does not correct eye sights well. Even if both eyes have poor eyesight, the monocle can only correct one eyesight, the other remaining the same and it could accompany dizziness and cause abnormalities in balance and perspective.
item_text_translated: Do monocles often have a string attached?

section_prompt_translated: A monocle is a type of eyeglasses that is also known as one eyeglass because of its distinctive characteristic which only fits in one eye. A monocle is made of a circular lens with a wire around it and a string attached to it. One end of the strap is usually attached to the clothes to prevent losing glasses. First seen in 1820 in England, the monocle was said to have been worn mainly by high-ranking officials, officers, and diplomats. It was dominantly worn by the upper class as a fashionable item rather than eye correction and it served as an accessory to the social status of the upper class, making it a symbol of the Prussian aristocracy. It was only widely popular not only in Great Britain where it was first produced but in modern Europe as well. The monocle was in vogue until the end of the 19th century and was briefly worn shortly after World War I and II; it was often worn by high-ranking German officers during World War II. Today, the monocle is not worn as often as before because it does not correct eye sights well. Even if both eyes have poor eyesight, the monocle can only correct one eyesight, the other remaining the same and it could accompany dizziness and cause abnormalities in balance and perspective.

section_prompt: 오렌지 주스는 오렌지를 누르거나 짜서, 혹은 부숴서 만든 과일 주스이다. 시중에 있는 오렌지 주스는 오렌지 주스라고 정의된 식품공전상 법 테두리 안에서 과채주스라고 정의된 오렌지 주스라고 보는게 정확하다. 공장에서 대량으로 착즙되어서 병입되는 오렌지 주스는 착즙 이후 병입 과정에서 유통, 보관을 위해 미생물 살균을 해야 하며 필터를 통해 오렌지 과육을 걸러낸다. 이 과정에서 오렌지 특유의 향과 산미와 핵심적으로 비타민 C의 일부를 잃게 되고, 살균과정을 거치면서 수분이 날아가고 자연스럽게 농축이 이뤄지게 된다. 농축 과정을 거쳐 나온 농축 과즙은 당도는 높아지고, 영양소는 가열로 인해 전부 파괴된다. 따라서 오렌지색과 단맛만 남은 농축액을 물에 희석해 비살균 오렌지 주스의 평균 당도에 맞추게 되는데, 단가를 낮추기 위해 물을 많이 넣을 경우 당도가 부족해지므로 여기에 설탕이나 액상과당을 첨가해 인위적으로 당도를 높인다. 저렴한 오렌지 주스의 경우 십중팔구 액상과당 같은 당이 첨가되는 이유가 여기에 있다.
section_prompt_translated: Orange juice is a type of a fruit juice made by pressing, squeezing, or crushing oranges. Commercial orange juice sold in the market is fruit juice defined as orange juice by the Food and Drug Administration. Orange juice that is processed in bulk in factories must undergo microbial pasteurization for distribution and storage during the packaging process, and the orange pulp is sifted through a filter. Such process removes the distinct aroma that give orange juice a fresh taste and some parts of vitamin C. Throughout pasteurization, it also loses moisture and concentrates naturally. Concentrated orange juice produced through the enrichment process increases sugar level, but nutrients are destroyed by heating. Therefore, the concentrate which has orange color and sugar content is diluted in water to meet the average sugar content of non-sterile orange juice; if you add a lot of water to lower the unit price, sugar or liquid fructose is added, which artificially increases the sugar content. Therefore, sugars such as liquid fructose is most likely added to cheap orange juice.

Such process removes the distinct aroma that give orange juice a fresh taste and some parts of vitamin C. Throughout pasteurization, it also loses moisture and concentrates naturally. Concentrated orange juice produced through the enrichment process increases sugar level, but nutrients are destroyed by heating. Therefore, the concentrate which has orange color and sugar content is diluted in water to meet the average sugar content of non-sterile orange juice; if you add a lot of water to lower the unit price, sugar or liquid fructose is added, which artificially increases the sugar content. Therefore, sugars such as liquid fructose is most likely added to cheap orange juice.

section_prompt: 양봉은 벌꿀 혹은 밀랍이나 화분, 로열젤리, 프로폴리스, 봉독액(봉침액), 수벌 번데기 등을 생산하기 위해서 꿀벌을 기르는 것을 의미한다. 농작물의 수분을 확실히 하기 위해서 즉, 꿀벌의 방화활동을 이용하여 생산량을 늘리기 위해 꿀벌을 치는 것을 의미하기도 한다. 전통적으로 한국에서는 벌을 치는 일을 한봉이라고 따로 구분하기도 하며 전통 방식은 채집통과 그것을 운영하는 방식이 차이가 있다. 한봉은 동양꿀벌이 꿀을 모아 벌집에 모은 것으로 감로벌꿀이라고도 한다. 한봉에 사용되는 토종벌은 서양벌에 비해 몸집의 크기가 작은 편이다. 꿀의 채취는 1년에 1번 첫 서리가 내릴 때 하며 장소의 이동 없이 한 곳에서만 채취를 하므로 일정 범위 내의 꽃 구성에 따라 그 꿀의 구성 성분이 제각각이게 된다. 반면, 양봉은 서양꿀벌이 꿀을 모아 벌집에 모은 것으로 꽃벌꿀이라고도 한다. 토종벌에 비해 덩치가 크고 공격성이 강해 주변에 토종벌이 있을 경우 공격하여 몰아내거나 거의 전쟁수준까지 가기도 하여 토종벌과의 공존은 불가능하다. 꽃이 있는 곳을 찾아서 벌통을 이동시키기도 하며 한봉이 채취를 1년에 1번 하는 것에 비해 양봉은 여러 번 채취를 한다.
item_text: 양봉은 농작물의 생산량을 높이는 데 기여할 수 있는가?
section_prompt_translated: Beekeeping is the cultivation of bees to produce honey, beeswax, bee pollen, royal jelly, propolis, bee venom for acupuncture, and bee pupa. It also means keeping bees to increase production by using the bee’s foraging activity to ensure crops are pollinated. “Hanbong” is a kind of method separately classified in South Korea, but there are traditional methods which differ in the container and the way bee keeping is being managed. Hanbong, also known as Gamro honey, is a collection of honey from oriental honeybees in a hive. The native bees used for Hanbong are smaller in size than that of western bees. Honey is collected annually when the first frost falls, and it is collected only in one place without any movement of place, which is why composition of the honey varies depending on the flowers in range. Yangbong, on the other hand, is a collection of honey from western honeybees in hives and is also known as honey of flower bees. They are larger and more aggressive compared to native bees; when there are native bees around, they can attack and drive them out or go almost to the level of war, which is why coexistence with native bees is impossible. It is also possible to move beehives where flowers are located, and thus Yangbong can be collected several times a year compared to “Hanbong” which is collected annually.

section_prompt_translated: Beekeeping is the cultivation of bees to produce honey, beeswax, bee pollen, royal jelly, propolis, bee venom for acupuncture, and bee pupa. It also means keeping bees to increase production by using the bee’s foraging activity to ensure crops are pollinated. “Hanbong” is a kind of method separately classified in South Korea, but there are traditional methods which differ in the container and the way bee keeping is being managed. Hanbong, also known as Gamro honey, is a collection of honey from oriental honeybees in a hive. The native bees used for Hanbong are smaller in size than that of western bees. Honey is collected annually when the first frost falls, and it is collected only in one place without any movement of place, which is why composition of the honey varies depending on the flowers in range. Yangbong, on the other hand, is a collection of honey from western honeybees in hives and is also known as honey of flower bees. They are larger and more aggressive compared to native bees; when there are native bees around, they can attack and drive them out or go almost to the level of war, which is why coexistence with native bees is impossible. It is also possible to move beehives where flowers are located, and thus Yangbong can be collected several times a year compared to “Hanbong” which is collected annually.

section_prompt_translated: Beekeeping is the cultivation of bees to produce honey, beeswax, bee pollen, royal jelly, propolis, bee venom for acupuncture, and bee pupa. It also means keeping bees to increase production by using the bee’s foraging activity to ensure crops are pollinated. “Hanbong” is a kind of method separately classified in South Korea, but there are traditional methods which differ in the container and the way bee keeping is being managed. Hanbong, also known as Gamro honey, is a collection of honey from oriental honeybees in a hive. The native bees used for Hanbong are smaller in size than that of western bees. Honey is collected annually when the first frost falls, and it is collected only in one place without any movement of place, which is why composition of the honey varies depending on the flowers in range. Yangbong, on the other hand, is a collection of honey from western honeybees in hives and is also known as honey of flower bees. They are larger and more aggressive compared to native bees; when there are native bees around, they can attack and drive them out or go almost to the level of war, which is why coexistence with native bees is impossible. It is also possible to move beehives where flowers are located, and thus Yangbong can be collected several times a year compared to “Hanbong” which is collected annually.

section_prompt: Nasjonalflagg er et flagg som symboliserer et land. Et flagg er en tøyduk med bestemte farger, proporsjoner og eventuelt også symbolske figurer, som heises på stang. I nyere tid blir flagg i første rekke brukt som nasjonalmerke, men det brukes også som kjennemerke for byer, institusjoner, foreninger, firmaer og mer. Flagg har utviklet seg fra bannere og faner, som kan føre sin historie tilbake til oldtiden. For det enkelte lands nasjonalflagg skilles det gjerne mellom statsflagg, handelsflagg(handelsflåten) og orlogsflagg (marinen). Det nasjonale flagget har juridisk betydning og eventuelle misbruk vil ha rettslige konsekvenser. Stats- og folkerettslig har flagget særlig betydning for samferdselen til sjøs. Flagget er et tegn på hvor et skip hører hjemme, og hver stat fastsetter selv reglene for at et skip skal ha rett til å føre sitt flagg. Ifølge folkeretten må det imidlertid foreligge en reell tilknytning mellom flaggstaten og skipet. Både selvstendige staters flagg og flagg for nasjoner forstått som kulturelle fellesskap omtales som nasjonalflagg. I sistnevnte betydning kan man regne Catalonias, Englands eller Skottlands flagg, men også eksempelvis det samiske flagget.
section_prompt_translated: The national flag is a flag symbolizing a country. A flag is a piece of cloth with certain colours, proportions and possibly also symbolic figures, that is hoisted on a pole. In recent times flags are mainly used as national symbols, but also as hallmarks for cities, institutions, associations, companies and more. Flags have developed from banners and tags with history back to ancient times. For each country’s national flag there will often be a distinction between state flag, trade flag (merchant fleet) and naval flags (navy). The national flag is of legal importance, and any abuse will have legal consequences. For states and international law, the flag has significant importance for maritime transport. The flag is a token of where a ship belongs, and every state determines its own rules for a ship having the right to use the flag. According to international law, however, there must be a genuine connection between the flag state and the ship. Both flags of independent states and flags for nations defined as cultural communities, are referred to as national flags. In the latter sense one can count the flags of Catalonia, England or Scotland, but also for instance the Saami flag.
item_text_translated: Flags are used only as a national emblem.

Et skjoldmerke kan i tillegg ha én eller flere figurer på eller utenfor skjoldet, slik som kongekronen på Norges riksvåpen, eller kongekrone, våpenkappe og ordenskjede i det norske kongevåpenet. Våpen som eget fagområde kalles heraldikk. Våpen er innenfor heraldikken et kjennetegn som føres av en stat, by, en institusjon eller en slekt. I gamle fyrstevåpen og i slektsvåpen er det mest vanlig at våpenets elementer består av skjold, hjelm, hjelmklede og hjelmtegn, uten andre tilleggsfigurer. De sentrale heraldiske normer, eller ledende synspunkter i middelalderen og i dag, er at figurer i våpen skal være generelle og abstrakte. Figurene skal ikke være for steds- og tidsbundne, de skal være egnet til sterk stilisering og et våpen bør helst bare inneholde én eller så få figurer som mulig. Norden fikk nye våpen etter omkring seksten hundre - tallet og bar ofte en utforming som brøt med middelalderens heraldiske praksis.

section_prompt_translated: Armory with the equivalent designations of coat of arms or crest arms, is a characteristic that consists of a color combination (tinctures) and figures that are usually used with an affiliation to a shield-shaped framing. In addition, a coat of arms can have one or more figures on-or outside the shield, like the crown in the Norwegian coat of arms.  Armory as a subject area is known as heraldry. In heraldry, the coats of arms are characterizing the state, city, institution or a family. In old princely armory and family crests, the common elements consisted of a shield and helmets without additional figures. The central heraldic norms, or leading views, in the medieval times and today, is that figures in coats of arms should be more general and abstract. The figures should not be bound to a place and time, they should be suitable for definite stylization, and a coat of arms should contain only one or a few figures if possible. In the north, new coats of arms were used  after the 16th century, and they often had a design that broke the practices of the medieval times.

section_prompt: Pungulv var det største, kjente kjøttetende pungdyret i moderne tid. Pungulv lignet en hund eller en hyene, men den hadde et lendeparti som klart skilte den fra canidene. Den er ofte kjent som den Tasmaniske tigeren, på grunn av den stripete korsryggen, eller den Tasmanske ulven (på grunn av dens hundeaktige utseende, trekk og egenskaper). Den kom fra det kontinentale Australia, Tasmania og New Guinea, og døde trolig ut på nittenhundretallet. Pungulven var ett av bare to pungdyr hvor begge kjønnene hadde pung. Hannen hadde en pung som beskyttet de ytre forplantningsorganene når han løp gjennom grove kratt. Pungulven blir beskrevet som et formidabelt rovdyr på grunn av sin evne til å overleve og jakte byttedyr i ekstremt tynt befolket områder. Pungulven var ekstremt sjelden eller utdødd på det australske fastlandet før den britiske bosetningen av kontinentet, men den overlevde på øya Tasmania. Intensiv jakt oppmuntret av dusører får vanligvis skylden for utryddelsen, men andre medvirkende faktorer kan ha vært sykdom, innføringen av hunder og menneskelig inngrep i dets habitat. Til tross for den offisielle klassifiseringen som utdødd, rapporteres observasjoner fortsatt, men ingen er endelig bevist.
section_prompt_translated: The marsupial wolf was the largest known carnivorous marsupial in modern times. The marsupial wolf resembled a dog, or a hyena, but it had a loin that clearly separated it from the canids. It is often known as the Tasmanian tiger, due to the striped lower back, or the Tasmanian wolf due to its canine appearance, features and characteristics. It came from continental Australia, Tasmania and New Guinea, and probably died out in the nineteenth century. The marsupial wolf was one of only two marsupials where both sexes had pouches. The male had a pouch that protected the external reproductive organs when he ran through rough bushes. The marsupial wolf is described as a formidable predator due to its ability to survive and hunt prey in extremely sparsely populated areas. The marsupial wolf was extremely rare or extinct on the Australian mainland before the British settlement of the continent, but it survived on the island of Tasmania. Intensive hunting encouraged by bounties is usually blamed for the extinction, but other contributing factors may have been disease, the introduction of dogs and human encroachment/intervention on its habitat. Despite the official classification as extinct, observations are still reported, but none have been conclusively proven.

item_text: Er juice en beskyttet varebetegnelse i Norge?
section_prompt_translated: Orange juice is raw juice that occurs when liquid is squeezed out of an orange. In Norway, and in a number of other countries, industrially produced juice dominates. Among these, a distinction is made between “freshly squeezed juice” and juice made from concentrate. Juice has a protected trade name in Norway, and the brand regulations require that the nutritional content of products called juice is the same as in the natural fruit juice. Concentrates can be added the same amount of water that was originally removed, but beyond that no additives are allowed in products that are referred to as juices. This includes, among other things, sugar and preservatives. Fruit and berry products with additives or lacking the fruit's natural and original balance between nutrients, are referred to as fruit nectar, lemonade or concentrated juice. Since oranges contain large amounts of water, many producers in countries without their own orange production use orange juice to make concentrate. After harvesting and pressing, the water is extracted from the juice, and then the concentrate is frozen. The concentrate takes up far less space, and is therefore much cheaper to transport. In the country of production, the concentrate is thawed and then added the same amount of water as was removed before shipment.

section_prompt: Birøkt er stell av honningbier for å høste honningen de lager. De fleste som selger honning har det kun som biinntekt, men noen har det som hovednæring. Honningproduksjonen er svært avhengig av faktorer som temperatur og klima, og den norske produksjonen kan dermed variere fra rundt tusen til over to tusen tonn per år. Mens ville honningbier lever i trestammer og lignende, oppbevarer birøkterne sine bier i kuber. Kubene ble tidligere laget av halm eller tre, men nå lages de for det meste av trykkfast isopor. Vokstavlene er det eneste inventaret i kuben. De er bygd opp av celler som vender vannrett ut fra en felles midtvegg. Byggematerialet er voks som biene produserer selv. Cellene er dels ammerom for yngelen og dels lagerrom for honning og pollen. Biene samler nektar i blomstene og lagrer den i cellene, hvor den omdannes til honning. Når honningen er moden, blir cellene forseglet med bivoks. På attenhundretallet vokste norsk birøkt kraftig. Dette skyldtes dels omveltningene i landbruket, som førte til en sterkere vilje til å prøve noe nytt, og dels nyvinninger i birøkten. Kubene ble sterkt forbedret ved at man fikk løse trerammer, der honningen kunne slynges ut ved at vokstavlene ble plassert i en sentrifuge. Dette førte til at man kunne hente ut honning uten å påføre stor skade på biene, og dermed kunne man beholde den viktigste råvaren – biene – fra år til år. Systemet med løse kasser er fortsatt nesten dominerende innenfor birøkt.

section_prompt_translated: Beekeeping is caring for honeybees in order to harvest their honey. Most people who sell honey have it as an extra source of income, but for some it will be their main business. Production of honey is very dependent on factors like temperature and climate, and the Norwegian production will thus vary from around a thousand to more than two thousand tons per year. While wild honeybees live in tree trunks and similar locations, the beekeepers store their bees in hives. The hives were previously made of straw or wood, but are nowadays for the most part made of pressure-resistant Styrofoam.  The wax boards are the only inventory of the hive. They are made up by cells placed horizontally on a shared wall in the middle. The building material is wax produced by the bees themselves. The cells are partly feeding rooms for the brood and partly storage rooms for the honey and pollen. The bees collect nectar from the flowers and store it in the cells, where it is converted into honey. When the honey is ripe, the cells are sealed with bee wax. In the nineteenth century Norwegian beekeeping grew rapidly. This was partly due to changes in agriculture that led to a stronger will of trying new things, and partly due to innovations within beekeeping itself. The hives were improved by separate wooden frames where the honey could be squeezed out by putting the wax boards in a centrifuge. This meant that you could get the honey out of them without causing much damage to the bees, and thus keep the most important raw material – the bees – from year to year. The system with loose boxes is still the dominant system within beekeeping.
item_text_translated: Honey production does not depend on the temperature.

Поэтому Янусу поклонялись перед сбором и посевом урожая, а также во время бракосочетаний, похорон и разных начинаний. У Януса не было своих жрецов, зато его церемонии отправлял сам верховный жрец. Янус олицетворял золотую середину между варварством и цивилизацией, деревней и городом, юностью и зрелостью. section_prompt_translated: Janus is the god of all beginnings, gates and transitions in ancient Roman religion and mythology. Janus, as the god of the gate, was also associated with the entrance and exit from the house. Janus often symbolized changes and transitions, for example, the transition from one state to another, from one worldview to another, from youth to adulthood. Therefore, Janus was worshipped before harvesting and sowing crops, as well as during weddings, funerals, and various undertakings. Janus had no priests of his own, but his ceremonies were conducted by the high priest himself. Janus represented the golden mean between barbarism and civilization, village and city, youth and adulthood. The ancient Greeks did not have a god like Janus, and the Romans proclaimed him as their deity exclusively.

instrument: MECO L1 (Multilingual Eye-movement Corpus, first-language reading task): yes/no comprehension questions
section_prompt: Национальный флаг — это флаг, который представляет и символизирует страну. Национальный флаг обычно создается по указу правительства страны, хотя также может быть предложен и ее гражданами. При разработке национального флага все его цвета и символы имеют определенное значение. Исторически флаги использовали в качестве военного знамени, чтобы обозначить расположение войск разных стран на поле боя. Только в начале семнадцатого века флаги стали использовать в мирное время. Национальный флаг, как правило, описан в конституции страны. Все национальные флаги имеют прямоугольную форму, за исключением единственного в своем роде треугольного флага Непала. Хотя пропорции флагов могут различаться, нет ни одного флага, у которого высота была бы больше ширины. Флаги Швейцарии и Ватикана — единственные национальные флаги, имеющие форму квадрата. Наиболее популярные цвета, используемые для национальных флагов, — красный, белый, зеленый и синий. Несмотря на то, что каждый национальный флаг создается как уникальный символ своей страны, многие флаги имеют очень похожие цвета и дизайн.
section_prompt_translated: A national flag is a flag that represents and symbolizes a country. Usually, the government of the country issues a decree creating the national flag, but it can also be proposed by the country's citizens. When a national flag is designed, all its colors and symbols have a certain meaning. Historically, flags were used as a military banner to indicate the location of troops from different countries on the battlefield. Only at the beginning of the seventeenth century did flags begin to be used in peacetime. The national flag is usually described in the country's constitution. All national flags are rectangular in shape, except for the one-of-a-kind triangular flag of Nepal. Although the proportions of the flags may vary, there is no flag which height is greater than its width. The flags of Switzerland and the Vatican are the only national flags that have the shape of a square. The most popular colors used for national flags are red, white, green, and blue. Even though each national flag is created as a unique symbol of their country, many flags have very similar colors and designs.

Все страны требуют регистрационных знаков для таких наземных транспортных средств, как легковые и грузовые автомобили, а также мотоциклы. Обязательны ли они для других видов транспорта, например, для велосипедов, лодок и тракторов, зависит от местных законов. Регистрационный номер — это комбинация букв и цифр, которая позволяет однозначно идентифицировать владельца транспортного средства в реестре номеров соответствующей административной единицы. В некоторых странах номера регистрируются в едином реестре, в других реестры ведутся в отдельных штатах или областях. Франция была первой страной, в которой ввели регистрационные номера, — там это случилось в конце девятнадцатого века. Номерные знаки в начале двадцатого века настолько отличались размером и формой в разных административных единицах, что тому, кто переезжал, приходилось сверлить в автомобиле новые отверстия, чтобы прикрепить новый знак. Стандартизация знаков была введена в конце пятидесятых годов, когда производители автомобилей пришли к соглашению с правительствами и международными организациями.
section_prompt_translated: A vehicle registration number is a metal or plastic plate that is placed on the vehicle for identification purposes. All countries require registration plates for such ground vehicles as cars, trucks, and motorcycles. Whether they are mandatory for other types of transport, such as bicycles, boats, or tractors, depends on local legislation. A registration number is a combination of letters and numbers that allows to uniquely identify the owner of a vehicle in the register of numbers of the corresponding administrative unit. In some countries, numbers are registered in a single register, in others, registers are maintained in separate states or regions. France was the first country to introduce registration numbers — it happened there at the end of the nineteenth century. License plates at the beginning of the twentieth century were so different in size and shape in different administrative units that someone who moved had to drill new holes in the car to attach a new plate. License plate standardization was introduced in the late fifties when car manufacturers came to an agreement with governments and international organizations.

instrument: MECO L1 (Multilingual Eye-movement Corpus, first-language reading task): yes/no comprehension questions
section_prompt: Жест «шака» — это знак дружеских намерений, который часто связывают с Гавайями и сёрф-культурой. Чтобы показать этот жест, нужно оттопырить большой палец и мизинец и прижать к ладони указательный, средний и безымянный пальцы, повернув ладонь передней или тыльной стороной к собеседнику. Для большей выразительности ладонь покачивают взад-вперёд. Жест «шака» был заимствован из традиционной гавайской культуры приезжими сёрферами в шестидесятых годах прошлого века и затем получил распространение по всему миру. В основном этот жест используют для приветствия, но им также можно выразить благодарность, поддержку или даже похвалу. Жители Гавайев используют шака, чтобы передать «дух Алоха»: идею дружбы, понимания, сострадания и солидарности между различными народами, живущими на Гавайях. Хотя точное происхождение знака неясно, некоторые предполагают, что он произошёл от испанских иммигрантов: они прижимали четыре пальца к ладони и прикладывали оттопыренный большой палец к губам в качестве дружеского жеста, изображая, что выпивают вместе с местными жителями.
section_prompt_translated: The shaka sign is a sign of friendly intentions, often associated with Hawaii and surf culture. To show this sign, you need to extend your thumb and smallest finger and press the index, middle and ring fingers to the palm, turning the front or back of the palm to the interlocutor. For greater expressiveness, the palm is swayed back and forth. The shaka sign was borrowed from traditional Hawaiian culture by visiting surfers in the 1960s and then spread around the world. This sign is mostly used for greeting, but it can also be used to express gratitude, support, or even praise. Hawaiians use shaka to convey the spirit of Aloha: the idea of friendship, understanding, compassion, and solidarity among the various peoples living in Hawaii. Although the exact origin of the sign is unclear, some suggest that it originated from Spanish immigrants: they pressed four fingers to the palm of their hand and put a stuck out thumb to their lips as a friendly gesture, pretending to drink with the locals.

section_prompt: В профессиональном спорте допингом называют применение спортсменами запрещенных стимулирующих веществ. Использование стимулирующих веществ для улучшения спортивных показателей, как правило, считается неэтичным и поэтому запрещено большинством международных спортивных организаций, включая Международный Олимпийский Комитет. Более того, спортсмены, которые прикладывают явные усилия, чтобы избежать разоблачения, усугубляют нарушение этических принципов открытым обманом и мошенничеством. Несмотря на недавнюю популярность этой темы в газетных заголовках, допинг — явление не новое, а такое же древнее, как и сам спорт. Начиная с древних гонок на колесницах и до недавних скандалов в бейсболе и велоспорте, взгляды спортсменов постоянно менялись в зависимости от эпохи. В последние десятилетия государственные органы и спортивные организации стараются строго контролировать использование стимулирующих веществ в спорте. Главные причины для запрета – это вред стимулирующих веществ для здоровья, обеспечение равных возможностей для спортсменов и положительный пример, который спорт без допинга подаёт общественности. Антидопинговые организации постоянно подчёркивают, что использование стимулирующих веществ противоречит духу спорта.

Despite the recent popularity of this topic in newspaper headlines, doping is not a new phenomenon but is as ancient as sport itself. Over the past decades, state bodies and sports organizations have been trying to strictly regulate the use of stimulants in sports. The main reasons for the ban are the health risks of stimulants, ensuring equal opportunities for athletes, and the positive example that sport without doping sets to the public. Anti-doping organizations constantly emphasize that the use of stimulants contradicts the spirit of sport.

Считается, что тилацин был грозным хищником, так как он успешно охотился и выживал в тех местах, где было очень мало добычи. Тилацин практически исчез или даже полностью вымер в материковой Австралии еще до прибытия британцев, но всё ещё водился на острове Тасмания, пока не подвергся массовому истреблению. instrument: MECO L1 (Multilingual Eye-movement Corpus, first-language reading task): yes/no comprehension questions
section_prompt: Монокль — это оптический прибор для коррекции зрения, используемый для одного глаза. Он состоит из одиночной линзы, как правило, с оправой. Оправа может быть оснащена цепочкой или шнурком, которые крепятся к одежде, чтобы не потерять монокль. Монокль вошёл в моду одновременно с пенсне и широко использовался со второй половины девятнадцатого века вплоть до Первой мировой войны. Монокль, как правило, носили мужчины — особую популярность он снискал среди гвардейских офицеров, особенно немецких, а также среди состоятельных людей из высших слоев общества. Несмотря на широкую распространенность этого аксессуара чуть больше века назад, сегодня монокли носят редко. В значительной степени это обусловлено достижениями в офтальмологии, благодаря которым аномалию рефракции теперь можно измерить более точно. В результате современные очки могут быть оснащены линзами разной силы для каждого глаза, с учётом индивидуальных особенностей зрения.
section_prompt_translated: A monocle is an optical vision correction device used for one eye. It consists of a single lens, usually with a frame. The frame can be equipped with a chain or a string that is attached to the clothes so as not to lose the monocle. The monocle came into fashion at the same time as the pince-nez and was widely used from the second half of the nineteenth century until the First World War. The monocle, as a rule, was worn by men — it gained particular popularity among Guard officers, especially German ones, as well as among wealthy people from the upper classes of society. Despite the widespread use of this accessory a little more than a century ago, today monocles are rarely worn. This is largely due to advances in ophthalmology, due to which refractive error can now be measured more accurately. As a result, modern glasses can be equipped with lenses of different strengths for each eye, taking into account the individual vision characteristics.

section_prompt_translated: Tasting is an assessment of a wine in terms of taste, smell, and appearance. Although wine tasting is a phenomenon as ancient as winemaking itself, a more or less formal methodology of tasting began to emerge gradually only starting from the late Middle Ages. Modern professional tasters use an ever-expanding terminology to convey a range of tastes, aromas, and general characteristics of wine. In recent years, some studies cast doubt on the reliability of the tasting results obtained by both experts and ordinary consumers. For instance, according to research results, people believe that a more expensive wine will have better characteristics than a less expensive one. When tasters are offered a wine that is incorrectly labeled as expensive, they almost always rate its taste higher than the taste of the same wine that was presented as cheap. Other studies show that the evaluation of wine by tasters is influenced by any information about it, for example, its geographical origin, reputation, and other characteristics. Therefore, for objective tasting, it is required that the wine is served blindly, that is, in a way that the taster does not see the label or the shape of the bottle. Blind tasting can also involve serving wine in a black glass to hide its color.

section_prompt_translated: A national flag is a flag that represents and symbolizes a country. Usually, the government of the country issues a decree creating the national flag, but it can also be proposed by the country's citizens. When a national flag is designed, all its colors and symbols have a certain meaning. Only at the beginning of the seventeenth century did flags begin to be used in peacetime. The national flag is usually described in the country's constitution. All national flags are rectangular in shape, except for the one-of-a-kind triangular flag of Nepal. Although the proportions of the flags may vary, there is no flag which height is greater than its width. The flags of Switzerland and the Vatican are the only national flags that have the shape of a square. The most popular colors used for national flags are red, white, green, and blue. Even though each national flag is created as a unique symbol of their country, many flags have very similar colors and designs.

Все страны требуют регистрационных знаков для таких наземных транспортных средств, как легковые и грузовые автомобили, а также мотоциклы. Обязательны ли они для других видов транспорта, например, для велосипедов, лодок и тракторов, зависит от местных законов. Регистрационный номер — это комбинация букв и цифр, которая позволяет однозначно идентифицировать владельца транспортного средства в реестре номеров соответствующей административной единицы. В некоторых странах номера регистрируются в едином реестре, в других реестры ведутся в отдельных штатах или областях. Франция была первой страной, в которой ввели регистрационные номера, — там это случилось в конце девятнадцатого века. Номерные знаки в начале двадцатого века настолько отличались размером и формой в разных административных единицах, что тому, кто переезжал, приходилось сверлить в автомобиле новые отверстия, чтобы прикрепить новый знак. Стандартизация знаков была введена в конце пятидесятых годов, когда производители автомобилей пришли к соглашению с правительствами и международными организациями.

section_prompt_translated: A vehicle registration number is a metal or plastic plate that is placed on the vehicle for identification purposes. All countries require registration plates for such ground vehicles as cars, trucks, and motorcycles. Whether they are mandatory for other types of transport, such as bicycles, boats, or tractors, depends on local legislation. A registration number is a combination of letters and numbers that allows to uniquely identify the owner of a vehicle in the register of numbers of the corresponding administrative unit. In some countries, numbers are registered in a single register, in others, registers are maintained in separate states or regions. France was the first country to introduce registration numbers — it happened there at the end of the nineteenth century. License plates at the beginning of the twentieth century were so different in size and shape in different administrative units that someone who moved had to drill new holes in the car to attach a new plate. License plate standardization was introduced in the late fifties when car manufacturers came to an agreement with governments and international organizations.

Despite the widespread use of this accessory a little more than a century ago, today monocles are rarely worn. section_prompt: Пчеловодство — отрасль сельского хозяйства, которая занимается разведением медоносных пчёл для получения мёда, пчелиного воска и других продуктов, а также для опыления сельскохозяйственных культур с целью повышения их урожайности. Пчеловодство было известно задолго до нашей эры — древнейшие изображения сделанных людьми ульев относятся ко временам Древнего Египта. Более четырех тысяч лет назад для разведения пчел там сооружали простейшие ульи, а полученный мед хранили в кувшинах — некоторые из них даже были найдены в гробницах фараонов. Принципы пчеловодства оставались практически неизменными до восемнадцатого века, когда открытия в области биологии привели к изобретению разборных ульев, что позволило добывать мед, не разрушая всю пчелиную колонию. В наши дни считается, что чем больше укусов получает пчеловод, тем меньшую реакцию вызывает каждый из них, поэтому в целях безопасности пчеловодам рекомендуют быть ужаленными несколько раз в сезон. Действительно, недавние исследования показали, что таким образом у пчеловодов вырабатывается высокий уровень антител, реагирующих на главный антиген пчелиного яда.
item_text: Правда ли, что пчеловодство было известно еще во времена Древнего Египта?
section_prompt_translated: Beekeeping is a branch of agriculture that raises honeybees to produce honey, beeswax, and other products, as well as to pollinate crops to increase their yield. More than four thousand years ago, simple hives were built there to breed bees, and the resulting honey was stored in jars — some of them were even found in the tombs of the pharaohs. The principles of beekeeping remained virtually unchanged until the eighteenth century, when discoveries in the field of biology led to the invention of collapsible hives, which made it possible to extract honey without destroying the entire bee colony. Nowadays, it is believed that the more bites a beekeeper receives, the smaller reaction each of them causes, so for safety reasons, beekeepers are recommended to be stung several times a season. Более четырех тысяч лет назад для разведения пчел там сооружали простейшие ульи, а полученный мед хранили в кувшинах — некоторые из них даже были найдены в гробницах фараонов. section_prompt_translated: Beekeeping is a branch of agriculture that raises honeybees to produce honey, beeswax, and other products, as well as to pollinate crops to increase their yield. Beekeeping was known long before our era — the oldest images of hives made by people date back to the times of Ancient Egypt. More than four thousand years ago, simple hives were built there to breed bees, and the resulting honey was stored in jars — some of them were even found in the tombs of the pharaohs. The principles of beekeeping remained virtually unchanged until the eighteenth century, when discoveries in the field of biology led to the invention of collapsible hives, which made it possible to extract honey without destroying the entire bee colony. Nowadays, it is believed that the more bites a beekeeper receives, the smaller reaction each of them causes, so for safety reasons, beekeepers are recommended to be stung several times a season. Indeed, recent studies have shown that this way beekeepers produce high levels of antibodies that respond to the main antigen in bee venom.

section_prompt: Nacionalna zastava je zastava koja simbolizuje zemlju. Ovu zastavu može da ističe vlada, a obično je mogu isticati i građani zemlje. Treba je razlikovati od državne zastave, koja predstavlja složeniju verziju nacionalne zastave, a koju može da ističe samo vlada. Istorijski posmatrano, nacionalne zastave potiču od vojnih standarda, koji su se koristili kao znak na borbenom polju. Praksa isticanja zastava koje predstavljaju zemlju, izvan konteksta ratovanja, postala je uobičajena sa pojavom pomorske zastave, koja je uvedena tokom vremena jedrenjaka. Sa pojavom nacionalnih osećanja krajem osamnaestog veka pojavila se želja da se nacionalne zastave ističu i u civilnom kontekstu. Jedan od najznačajnijih ranih primera predstavlja američka zastava, koja je usvojena kao pomorksa zastava, ali je nakon američke revolucije počela da se prikazuje kao simbol Sjedinjenih Država. Na sličan način, francuska trobojka je postala simbol Republike. Većina evropskih zemalja usvojila je svoje nacionalne zastave tokom devetnaestog i početkom dvadesetog veka, na osnovu starijih (srednjovekovnih) ratnih zastava.
section_prompt_translated: A national flag is a flag that symbolizes a country. This flag can be flown by the government, and it can usually be also flown by the citizens of the country. It should be distinguished from the state flag, which is a more complex version of the national flag, which can be flown only by the government. Historically speaking, national flags are derived from military standards, which were used as an insignia on the battlefield. The practice of displaying flags representing the country, outside of the context of warfare, became common with the advent of the naval ensign, which was introduced during the age of sail. With the emergence of national sentiments at the end of the eighteenth century, there was a desire to highlight national flags in a civilian context as well. One of the most significant early examples is the American flag, which was adopted as a naval flag, but after the American Revolution began to be displayed as a symbol of the United States. In a similar way, the French tricolor became the symbol of the Republic. Most European countries adopted their national flags during the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, based on older (medieval) war flags.

section_prompt: Torbarski vuk, tilacin, tasmanijski vuk ili tasmanijski tigar je bio najveći torbar mesožder savremenog doba, kog su istrebili ljudi u dvadesetom veku. Nekada je naseljavao Australiju i Novu Gvineju, a poslednje utočište mu je bila Tasmanija. Na ovom ostrvu nije bilo konkurentskog dinga, pa se tu održao sve do dolaska Evropljana. Izgledom je podsećao na vuka ili psa, sa šarama na leđima sličnim tigrovim. Sličan oblik tela torbarskog vuka i psa je posledica konvergentne evolucije, pošto ove vrste nisu u bliskom srodstvu. I mužjak i ženka su imali torbu, a kod mužjaka je ona služila zaštiti semenika. Mogao je da razjapi vilice do ugla od stotinu i dvadeset stepeni i imao je pokrete slične kengurovom skoku. Istrebljen je lovom, kao štetočina koja napada ovce, uništavano mu je stanište i dovedena konkurencija u vidu pasa. Nepoznata zarazna bolest je drastično smanjila brojnost njegove populacije. Proglašen je izumrlom vrstom, pa je pokrenut projekat kloniranja torbarskog vuka.
section_prompt_translated: Marsupial wolf, thylacine, tasmanian wolf  or tasmanian tiger was the largest contemporary carsupial carnevour, exterminated by people in twentieth centuary. Once upon a time it inhabited Australia and New Guinea, and its last resort was Tasmania. On this island there was no competitive dingo, so there it survived until the arrival of Europeans. Its looks resembled a wolf or a dog, with patterns on the back similar to tiger’s. Similar body shape of marsupial wolf and dog is a consequence of converging evolution, since these two species were not close related. Both male and female had a pouch, and male’s  had function to protect the stamen. It could gape the jar at the angle of hundred and twenty degrees and it had movements similar to kangaroo jumps. It was extinct by hunt, as a pest attacking sheep, its habitat was destroyed and the competition in a form of dog was brought. Unknown infectious disease drastically reduce number in the population. It was declared extinct species so the movement of cloning of marsupial wolf started.

instrument: MECO L1 (Multilingual Eye-movement Corpus, first-language reading task): yes/no comprehension questions
section_prompt: Svetski dan zaštite životne sredine (ili okoline) je dan koji se obeležava u celom svetu svakog petog juna kroz razne aktivnosti i kampanje. Cilj je da se skrene pažnja javnosti na brojne ekološke probleme i potrebu očuvanja životne sredine. U svetu se na ovaj dan pokreću brojne aktivnosti u koje je uključena javnost, a koje propagiraju odgovorni odnos prema okruženju. U pomenute aktivnosti se jednako uključuje i vladin i nevladin sektor. Pri tome, svake godine za glavno mesto proslave se bira drugi grad. Vlada zemlje koja je domaćin ili grad domaćin u saradnji sa Ujedinjenim Nacijama određuju temu događaja. Osim teme, biraju se i slogan i logo koji će biti fokus svih informativnih materijala i promotivnih aktivnosti u vezi sa ovim danom. Primer je akcija koju je 2011. godine pokrenula Indija, svetski domaćin te godine, a pod nazivom „Šume: Priroda u tvojoj službi“. Kao i svake godine, planirano je više aktivnosti; radionica za preko stotinu novinara, sednica sa temom o „zelenoj ekonomiji“, organizacija maratona, jednodnevna konferencija za žene rukovodioce itd.
section_prompt_translated: World Environment Day is a day that is celebrated all over the world every fifth of June through various activities and campaigns. The goal is to draw the public's attention to numerous ecological problems and the need to preserve the environment. On this day, numerous activities involving the public are launched around the world, which promote a responsible attitude towards the environment. The governmental and non-governmental sectors are equally involved in the mentioned activities. At the same time, every year a different city is chosen as the main place of the celebration. The government of the host country or host city in cooperation with the United Nations determines the theme of the event. In addition to the theme, a slogan and a logo which will be the focus of all informative materials and promotional activities related to this day, are also chosen. An example is the action launched in 2011 by India, the world host that year, under the name "Forests: Nature at your service". As every year, more activities are planned; a workshop for over a hundred journalists, a session on the topic of "green economy", the organization of a marathon, a one-day conference for women managers, etc.

Cilj je da se skrene pažnja javnosti na brojne ekološke probleme i potrebu očuvanja životne sredine. U svetu se na ovaj dan pokreću brojne aktivnosti u koje je uključena javnost, a koje propagiraju odgovorni odnos prema okruženju. U pomenute aktivnosti se jednako uključuje i vladin i nevladin sektor. Pri tome, svake godine za glavno mesto proslave se bira drugi grad. Vlada zemlje koja je domaćin ili grad domaćin u saradnji sa Ujedinjenim Nacijama određuju temu događaja. Osim teme, biraju se i slogan i logo koji će biti fokus svih informativnih materijala i promotivnih aktivnosti u vezi sa ovim danom. Primer je akcija koju je 2011. godine pokrenula Indija, svetski domaćin te godine, a pod nazivom „Šume: Priroda u tvojoj službi“. Kao i svake godine, planirano je više aktivnosti; radionica za preko stotinu novinara, sednica sa temom o „zelenoj ekonomiji“, organizacija maratona, jednodnevna konferencija za žene rukovodioce itd.
section_prompt_translated: World Environment Day is a day that is celebrated all over the world every fifth of June through various activities and campaigns. The goal is to draw the public's attention to numerous ecological problems and the need to preserve the environment. On this day, numerous activities involving the public are launched around the world, which promote a responsible attitude towards the environment. The governmental and non-governmental sectors are equally involved in the mentioned activities. At the same time, every year a different city is chosen as the main place of the celebration. The government of the host country or host city in cooperation with the United Nations determines the theme of the event. In addition to the theme, a slogan and a logo which will be the focus of all informative materials and promotional activities related to this day, are also chosen. An example is the action launched in 2011 by India, the world host that year, under the name "Forests: Nature at your service". As every year, more activities are planned; a workshop for over a hundred journalists, a session on the topic of "green economy", the organization of a marathon, a one-day conference for women managers, etc.

instrument: MECO L1 (Multilingual Eye-movement Corpus, first-language reading task): yes/no comprehension questions
section_prompt: Monokl je vrsta okruglog optičkog stakla koje se stavlja na jedno oko. Sastoji se od optičkog sočiva oivičenog u obliku kruga i kanapa ili žice za koji je zakačeno. Staklo se drži tako što se korisnik „namršti“ i mišićima oka drži staklo. To je, naravno, neprijatno i zamorno, pa se monokl koristi samo da bi se nešto pogledalo. Sam monokl se uglavnom držao u jednom džepčiću i povremeno vadio. Najpopularniji je bio krajem devetnaestog veka kada su ga uglavnom nosili imućniji ljudi. Monokl se u prošlosti više koristio, a danas ga koriste pojedinci, kao što su sajdžije, filatelisti i numizmatičari. U današnje vreme mnogo veću popularnost imaju naočari, jer omogućavaju različitu korekciju na dva oka. Okviri za naočare najčešće se izrađuju od metala ili plastike. Sočiva su prvotno bila od stakla, dok su danas mnoga izrađena od različitih tipova plastike, uključujući i polikarbonat. Ovi materijali umanjuju mogućnost loma i lakši su od stakla. Neki plastični materijali imaju bolje optičke karakteristike od stakla, kao što su bolja transmisija vidljivog svetla i apsorpcija ultraljubičastog svetla.
section_prompt_translated: A monocle is a type of round optical glass that is placed over one eye. It consists of an optical lens bordered in the shape of a circle and a string or wire to which it is attached. The glass is held by the user frowning and using the eye muscles to hold the glass. This is, of course, uncomfortable and tiring, so the monocle is used only to look at something. The monocle itself was generally kept in one pocket and taken out occasionally. It was most popular at the end of the nineteenth century when it was mostly worn by wealthier people. The monocle was used more in the past, and today it is used by individuals such as collectors, philatelists and numismatists. Nowadays, glasses are much more popular, because they allow different correction in two eyes. Eyeglass frames are usually made of metal or plastic. Lenses were originally made of glass, while today many are made of different types of plastic, including polycarbonate. These materials reduce the possibility of breakage and are lighter than glass. Some plastic materials have better optical properties than glass, such as better transmission of visible light and absorption of ultraviolet light.

instrument: MECO L1 (Multilingual Eye-movement Corpus, first-language reading task): yes/no comprehension questions
section_prompt: Sok od pomorandže je vrsta bezalkoholnog pića koje se dobija ceđenjem pomorandži. Sok se može pripremiti kod kuće od svežeg voća koristeći razne ručne ili električne sokovnike. Mnogi komercijalni sokovi su filtrirani da bi se uklonila vlakna ili pulpa, mada je i sok s visokim sadržajem pulpe popularno piće. Sokovi se često piju zbog dobrog uticaja po zdravlje, na primer, sok od narandže sadrži vitamin C, folnu kiselinu i kalijum. Međutim, konzumiranje soka u većim količinama može dovesti do gojaznosti, a ispijanje previše soka koji sadrži veliku količinu fruktoze dovodi do dijabetesa. Takođe, često se dešava da zbog šećera, zaslađivača, emulgatora, veštačkih boja i konzervansa voćni sok može biti više štetan nego koristan po zdravlje organizma.
section_prompt_translated: Orange juice is a type of soft drink obtained by squeezing oranges. Juice can be prepared at home from fresh fruit using a variety of manual or electric juicers. Many commercial juices are filtered to remove fiber or pulp, although juice with a high pulp content is also a popular drink. Juices are often drunk for their health benefits, for example, orange juice contains vitamin C, folic acid and potassium. However, consuming large amounts of juice can lead to obesity, and drinking too much fructose-containing juice can lead to diabetes. Also, it often happens that because of sugar, sweeteners, emulsifiers, artificial colors and preservatives, fruit juice can be more harmful than beneficial to the health of the organism.

section_prompt: Pčelarstvo je vrsta poljoprivrednog zanimanja koje podrazumeva gajenje i iskorišćavanje medonosne pčele u košnicama. Pčelarstvo je jedno od najranijih zanimanja čoveka. Starije je od ratarstva, pa možda i od stočarstva. Najstariji podatak o pčelarstvu potiče iz kamenog doba. Predak današnjeg čoveka nije uzgajao pčele, već ih je tražio u šupljinama drveća i stena. Rani oblici sakupljanja meda podrazumevali su uništenje celokupne kolonije kada je med bio sakupljan. Divlju košnicu su grubo uništavali pomoću dima za potiskivanje pčela, satne osnove su razbijali - zajedno sa jajima, larvama i medom koji su zadržavali. Ovo je bilo destruktivno i nehigijenski, ali za društva lovaca sakupljača to nije bilo važno, pošto se med generalno konzumirao odmah i uvek je bilo više divljih kolonija da ih eksploatišu.
section_prompt_translated: Beekeeping is a type of agricultural occupation that involves the cultivation and exploitation of honey bees in hives. Beekeeping is one of the earliest occupations of man. It is older than farming, and maybe even cattle breeding. The oldest information about beekeeping dates from the Stone Age. The ancestor of today's man did not raise bees, but looked for them in the hollows of trees and rocks. Early forms of honey collection involved the destruction of the entire colony when the honey was collected. Wild beehives were brutally destroyed using smoke to suppress the bees, honeycomb foundartions were broken - along with the eggs, larvae and honey they contained. This was destructive and unsanitary, but for hunter-gatherer societies this did not matter, as honey was generally consumed immediately and there were always more wild colonies to exploit.

instrument: MECO L1 (Multilingual Eye-movement Corpus, first-language reading task): yes/no comprehension questions
section_prompt: El monóculo es un tipo de lente correctivo usado para ajustar la visión en un solo ojo, que consiste en un cristal circular con aumento. En muchos casos está enmarcado en un anillo de alambre que posee una cadenilla o cordón que se sujeta a la ropa para evitar su pérdida. Si bien se conocen usuarios de monóculos desde el siglo dieciocho, este elemento no se convirtió en un artículo incorporado al vestuario masculino hasta entrado el siglo diecinueve. El monóculo estuvo generalmente asociado a hombres ricos pertenecientes a la clase alta. Combinado con un frac y un sombrero de copa, completaba el traje del estereotipo del capitalista de fines de ese siglo. Los monóculos estuvieron también asociados a los militares alemanes de ese periodo hasta la Primera Guerra Mundial. Los monóculos no eran incómodos como a veces se cree. Adaptados en forma conveniente, se usaban sin esfuerzo. Por ello, las clases adineradas usaban monóculos hechos a medida y que necesitaban de ajustes a lo largo de su vida útil. La opinión popular era que un monóculo podía caerse fácilmente con una expresión facial inesperada. Ello fue sumamente explotado en las comedias: el elegante caballero que se asusta o asombra y su monóculo que cae al suelo o dentro de su copa.
section_prompt_translated: The monocle is a type of corrective lens used to adjust vision in only one eye. It consists of a circular-shaped magnifying lens. In many cases, it is framed in a wire ring with a chain or string attached to the clothes in order to avoid losing it. Although monocles’ users are known since the eighteenth century, this object did not become part of masculine clothing until late in the nineteenth century. The monocle became generally associated wealthy upper-class men.  Combined with a tailcoat and a top hat, it completed the stereotypical suit of the capitalist of the end of that century. Monocles were also associated with German militaries from that period until World War I. Monocles were not uncomfortable as they are believed to be. Once they were conveniently adapted, they were used effortlessly.  Due to this reason, the wealthy class used tailor-made monocles that needed adjustment along their shelf life. The popular opinion was that monocles could easily fall with an unexpected facial expression. This was widely exploited in comedies: the elegant gentleman that gets scared and its monocle falls to the floor or inside his wine glass.

En muchos casos está enmarcado en un anillo de alambre que posee una cadenilla o cordón que se sujeta a la ropa para evitar su pérdida. Si bien se conocen usuarios de monóculos desde el siglo dieciocho, este elemento no se convirtió en un artículo incorporado al vestuario masculino hasta entrado el siglo diecinueve. El monóculo estuvo generalmente asociado a hombres ricos pertenecientes a la clase alta. Combinado con un frac y un sombrero de copa, completaba el traje del estereotipo del capitalista de fines de ese siglo. Los monóculos estuvieron también asociados a los militares alemanes de ese periodo hasta la Primera Guerra Mundial. Los monóculos no eran incómodos como a veces se cree. Adaptados en forma conveniente, se usaban sin esfuerzo. Por ello, las clases adineradas usaban monóculos hechos a medida y que necesitaban de ajustes a lo largo de su vida útil. La opinión popular era que un monóculo podía caerse fácilmente con una expresión facial inesperada. Ello fue sumamente explotado en las comedias: el elegante caballero que se asusta o asombra y su monóculo que cae al suelo o dentro de su copa.
section_prompt_translated: The monocle is a type of corrective lens used to adjust vision in only one eye. It consists of a circular-shaped magnifying lens. In many cases, it is framed in a wire ring with a chain or string attached to the clothes in order to avoid losing it. Although monocles’ users are known since the eighteenth century, this object did not become part of masculine clothing until late in the nineteenth century. The monocle became generally associated wealthy upper-class men.  Combined with a tailcoat and a top hat, it completed the stereotypical suit of the capitalist of the end of that century. Monocles were also associated with German militaries from that period until World War I. Monocles were not uncomfortable as they are believed to be. Once they were conveniently adapted, they were used effortlessly.  Due to this reason, the wealthy class used tailor-made monocles that needed adjustment along their shelf life. The popular opinion was that monocles could easily fall with an unexpected facial expression. This was widely exploited in comedies: the elegant gentleman that gets scared and its monocle falls to the floor or inside his wine glass.

section_prompt: El jugo de naranja es un jugo de frutas en forma de líquido obtenido de exprimir el interior de las naranjas, generalmente con un exprimidor. Sus usos culinarios son diversos, aunque principalmente se consume como refresco. Hoy en día puede adquirirse exprimido en casi cualquier supermercado, en sus versiones con y sin pulpa. Si bien ya contiene gran cantidad de vitamina C en su versión natural, algunas fábricas añaden ácido cítrico o vitamina C a sus productos, además de otros nutrientes como el calcio y la vitamina D. El jugo de naranja se utiliza en muchos desayunos del mundo; también se emplea en la elaboración de algunos tragos como el vodka naranja o la sangría. Por su carácter ácido, se emplea en la elaboración de salsas agridulces o en preparaciones como el cebiche o algunas vinagretas para ensaladas. A veces se utiliza en la preparación de alimentos como un ingrediente más, por ejemplo, en la preparación de tortas y postres.
section_prompt_translated: Orange juice is a liquid fruit juice obtained from squeezing the inner part of the orange, generally with a squeezer. Their culinary uses are diverse, although it is mainly consumed as a soft drink. Nowadays it can be acquired already squeezed at almost any supermarket, in its versions with or without pulp. Although it already contains a great amount of vitamin C in its natural version, several manufacturers add citric acid or vitamin C to their products, apart from other nutrients like calcium and vitamin D. Orange juice is used in many breakfasts all around the world; it is also used in the production of several drinks like the screwdriver and sangria. Given its acid character, it is employed for manufacturing bittersweet sauces or in preparations like cebiche or salad dressings. Sometimes it is used as an ingredient in the preparation of foods, for example, in the preparation of cakes and desserts.

section_prompt: La bandera nacional es una bandera que representa a un país, que indica nacionalidad. Es uno de los símbolos más importantes que tiene una nación. La bandera nacional sirve para representar al país en el extranjero, pero también como representación de los ciudadanos o del gobierno en el propio país. Cuando la bandera nacional se usa en el mar se denomina pabellón nacional. Existen tres categorías de banderas nacionales, según su uso: La bandera civil, la bandera de guerra y la bandera institucional. Cuando ocurre un trágico suceso nacional o fallece una persona que se desea honrar, las banderas nacionales ondean a media asta en señal de duelo. Si el mástil o asta no permite este tipo de izado, se debe colocar un crespón negro en el paño, pero nunca las dos cosas a la vez. section_prompt: El lobo marsupial o tilacino, también conocido como lobo de Tasmania, tigre de Tasmania o tilacín, fue un marsupial carnívoro originado en el Holoceno. Era nativo de Australia, Tasmania y Nueva Guinea y se cree que se extinguió en el siglo XX. Se trataba del último miembro viviente de su género, cuyos otros miembros vivieron en tiempos prehistóricos a partir de principios del Mioceno. El lobo marsupial se extinguió en la Australia continental miles de años antes de la llegada de los colonos europeos, pero sobrevivió en la isla de Tasmania junto con otras especies endémicas, como el diablo de Tasmania. Generalmente suele culparse de su extinción a la caza intensiva incentivada por recompensas, pero podrían haber contribuido otros factores, como por ejemplo las enfermedades, la introducción de los perros, o la ocupación de su hábitat por los humanos. A pesar de su clasificación oficial como extinto todavía se informan avistamientos, aunque ninguno ha sido probado de manera concluyente. Su pariente vivo más próximo es el demonio de Tasmania.

section_prompt_translated: The thylacine, also known as Tasmanian wolf, or Tasmanian tiger, was a carnivorous marsupial with origin in the Holocene. It was native of Australia, Tasmania and New Guinea and it is believed to be extinct since the 20th Century. It was the last living member of its genus whose other members lived in prehistoric times since the beginning of the Miocene. The marsupial wolf got extinct in continental Australia thousands of years before the arrival of the European settlers, but survived in the island of Tasmania along with other endemic species, like the Tasmanian devil. Intensive hunting encouraged by bounties is generally blamed for its extinction, but other contributing factors include diseases, the introduction of dogs or the occupation of their habitat by humans. Despite its official classification as extinct, sightings are still reported, although none has been conclusively proved. Its closest living relative is the Tasmanian devil.

section_prompt: Teleskop, uzaydan gelen her türlü radyasyonu alıp görüntüleyen astronomların kullandığı, bir rasathane cihazıdır. On yedinci yüzyılın başında Hollandalı bir gözlük üreticisi tarafından icat edilmiş ve ilk defa Galileo Galilei tarafından gökyüzü gözlemleri yapmakta kullanılmıştır. Objektif cinsine göre kırıcı ve yansıtıcı olmak üzere iki çeşit teleskop vardır. Teleskobun gücü, topladığı ışık miktarıyla orantılıdır, objektif çapı büyüdükçe ışık toplama kabiliyeti de artar. Teleskopta teşekkül eden görüntünün netliği ise atmosferin menfi yönde etkisine bağlı olarak değişir. Teleskoptaki kararlılık iki yay saniyesi için geçerlidir. Atmosfer şartları, bazen bu açıda saplamalara neden olabilir. Bu durumda inceleme yapılan yıldız değil de yakınındaki diğer yıldıza ait görüntüler kaydedilebilir. Uzaydaki cisimlerden yansıyarak veya doğrudan doğruya gelen, gözle görülen veya görülemeyen ışık ve radyo dalgaları gibi her türlü elektromanyetik yayınlar evren hakkında bilgi toplamaya yarayan önemli delillerdir. Bu deliller ya klasik manada optik teleskoplarla veya çok daha modern radyo teleskoplarla incelenir.
item_text: Teleskop ilk defa Hollandalı bir gözlük üreticisi tarafından mı icat edilmiştir?
section_prompt_translated: The telescope is an observatory device used by astronomers that receives and displays all kinds of radiation from space. It was invented by a Dutch spectacle maker at the beginning of the seventeenth century and was first used by Galileo Galilei to make sky observations. There are two types of telescopes, refracting and reflecting, depending on the lens type. The power of the telescope is proportional to the amount of light it gathers, the larger the lens diameter, the greater the light-gathering capability. The clarity of the image formed in the telescope changes depending on the negative effect of the atmosphere. The stability in the telescope is valid for two arcseconds. Atmospheric conditions may sometimes cause angular deviations. In this case, images of the star nearby, not the star being examined, can be recorded. All kinds of electromagnetic emissions, such as visible or invisible light and radio waves, reflected from matters in space or direct, are important evidences for collecting information about the universe. These evidences are examined either with classical optical telescopes or with much more modern radio telescopes.
item_text_translated: Was the telescope first invented by a Dutch spectacle maker?

section_prompt: Arıcılık, balarısı kolonilerinin beslenmesi ve bakımı ile arı ürünleri üretme faaliyetidir. Zirai kazanç elde etmeyi amaçlayanların yanında arıların soyunu devam ettirmek isteyenler tarafından da hobi olarak yapılmaktadır. Arıcılıkta bal ile birlikte balmumu, polen ve arı sütü gibi arı ürünleri de elde edilebilir. Arıcılık, eskiden dededen, babadan, komşudan görerek yetişmiş arıcılar tarafından geleneksel yöntemlerle yapılmıştır. Günümüzde ise bilimsel ve teknolojik gelişmelerin arıcılık alanında yarattığı gelişmelere paralel olarak daha modern yöntemlere dayalı üretim modellerine geçiş yapılmıştır. Bal, tarih öncesi dönemlerden itibaren hem dinsel ve büyüsel içerikli ritüellerde hem de geleneksel tedavi, beslenme geleneği ve halk edebiyatı içinde çeşitli şekillerde yer almış kültürel bir üründür. Örneğin, okunan tabletler eski Mısırlıların dört bin yıl öncesinden beri balı besin, ilaç ve dini amaçlarla kullandıklarını göstermektedir. İspanya'nın güney bölgesindeki bir mağaranın duvarında bulunan arıcı tasvirleri ise arıcılığın yaklaşık olarak on beş bin yıllık geçmişi olduğunu göstermektedir. Bu yüzden arıcılığın tarihi neredeyse insanlık tarihi kadar eskidir.
section_prompt_translated: Beekeeping is the activity of feeding and maintaining honeybee colonies and producing bee products. It is done as a hobby by those who aim to gain agricultural income as well as those who want to continue the lineage of bees. In beekeeping, bee products such as beeswax, pollen and royal jelly can be obtained along with honey. Beekeeping used to be done with traditional methods by beekeepers who were trained by observing their grandfathers, fathers and neighbours. Today, in parallel with the developments in the field of beekeeping, production models based on more modern methods have been made. Honey is a cultural product that has taken place in religious and magical rituals as well as in traditional treatment, nutritional tradition and folk literature since prehistoric times. For example, the tablets read show that the ancient Egyptians used honey for nutrition, medicine and religious purposes since four thousand years ago. Depictions of beekeepers found on the wall of a cave in the southern region of Spain indicate that beekeeping has a history of approximately fifteen thousand years. Therefore, the history of beekeeping is almost as old as the history of humanity.
